items.title: Constitutional and Ponytail alignment
items.summary: Verify the formation concept against Constitutional Architectonics, current Architectonic contracts, and the Ponytail reuse/delete ladder.
acceptance: Alignment names source limits and does not invent unavailable paper definitions
Purpose and success precede provisional form, evidence classification, authority, and consequence
MVP deletes custom scanning, ontology, credential, deployment, graph, and hosted-relay systems

items.title: Spec Kit feature contract and clean Rail
items.summary: Create a branch-local Spec Kit constitution, feature specification, plan, tasks, and one canonical Rail initialized empty before ticket population.
acceptance: Feature has independently testable user stories
Plan passes the branch constitution check
Rail is the only live ticket status authority

items.title: Implement plan-only Origin start command
items.summary: Add a thin CLI dispatcher and a bounded formation module that reuses status JSON, captures purpose before provisional form, selects an inference candidate, and emits a zero-mutation plan.
acceptance: Existing commands delegate to packages/workframe/bin/workframe.js unchanged
Output contains authorization_required=true, inspected_paths=[], and mutations=[]
No provider call, path inspection, filesystem mutation, or new dependency

items.title: Verify and document the minimal slice
items.summary: Add one standard-library test, update package documentation, run the final Ponytail diff review, and record fixture-backed local evidence without overstating package proof.
acceptance: Node syntax checks pass for the exact new files against a faithful status fixture
Purpose-first order, form parsing, candidate priority, zero-mutation output, and command execution are checked
Package README states start is experimental and plan-only
Final diff has no avoidable dependency, duplicate authority, speculative abstraction, or future feature implementation
items.notes: The container lacked outbound DNS and an actual Workframe checkout. This item records exact-new-file fixture execution only; packed and cross-platform proof remains ORI-005.

items.title: Cross-platform package verification
items.summary: Run the packed CLI on supported host environments and prove the new dispatcher preserves the actual current status command.
acceptance: Packed branch npm artifact runs on Windows
At least one macOS or Linux packed run is recorded
Actual current status --json output remains compatible
Interactive start is checked in a real TTY
